ShowAmount.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchant.maps_to: NimbleEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:424-426) -- base plus `card.gains_block`, matching Nimble.cs:7-14's `card.GainsBlock`. GainsBlock is an explicit per-card declaration in the source, mirrored as the Card.gains_block class attribute, and test_shared_enchantments.py::test_nimble_requires_gains_block pins the three interesting cases (Defend yes, Iron Wave yes, Strike no, Entrench yes with no printed number, Feel No Pain no). Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

EnchantBlockAdditive.maps_to: NimbleEnchantment.modify_block_additive (enchantments.py:428-431) -- returns `amount` for its own card, matching Nimble.cs:16-19's `base.Amount`. The grant sets amount 2 (events/self_help_book.py:13 _AMOUNT = 2, matching SelfHelpBook.cs's Enchantment2Amount). Additive-only, so BR-1's phase difference cannot bite (executed control in `py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py order`).
